title: 2024 AMC 10B Problem 6
statement: A rectangle has integer side lengths and an area of \(2024.\) What is the least possible perimeter of the rectangle?

solutions.text: The perimeter \(2(\ell + w)\) with \(\ell w = 2024\) is smallest when \(\ell\) and \(w\) are as close together as possible. Factor \(2024 = 2^3 \cdot 11 \cdot 23.\) The divisor pair nearest \(\sqrt{2024} \approx 45\) is \(44 \times 46,\) which gives perimeter \(2(44 + 46) = 180.\) Therefore, the answer is B.
hints: For a fixed area, the perimeter is smallest when the two sides are as close to equal as possible
\(2024 = 2^3 \cdot 11 \cdot 23;\) look for a factor pair near \(\sqrt{2024} \approx 45\)
